about.title: Top Brands Arabian Trading Co
about.description: TBA is a Saudi company specialized in importing and distributing luxury food products. Since our establishment, we have focused on providing high-quality imported food products including luxury coffee and chocolate, in addition to a wide range of sweets, biscuits and international products. Through a comprehensive distribution network that includes branches and warehouses across the Kingdom, we are always keen to meet the needs of the Saudi market and provide the best shopping experience for our customers.

vision.description: To be the leading distributor of luxury food products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, with international expansion into the confectionery and luxury food products sector.

mission.description: At TBA, we import and distribute high-quality food products that align with the latest trends. Our global partnerships ensure premium products are always available in Saudi Arabia at competitive prices.

items.title: Different kinds of sweets
items.excerpt: When it comes to celebrating special moments or simply indulging in a delightful treat, exploring the different kinds of sweets available can truly elevate the experience. At TBA, a leading Saudi company specialized in importing and distributing luxury food products, we offer an exquisite variety of ready-made sweets that cater to every taste and occasion. Whether you are planning a hospitality event, looking for elegant gifts, or simply want to enjoy high-quality desserts at home, our selection covers different kinds of sweets that guarantee satisfaction and sophistication.

items.title: Breakfast cereals
items.excerpt: When it comes to starting your day right, breakfast cereals are a popular and convenient choice for millions. Whether you’re looking for a quick meal for busy mornings or a nutritious option to fuel your body, selecting the right cereal can make all the difference. At TBA, a leading Saudi company specializing in importing and distributing premium food products, we offer a wide variety of high-quality breakfast cereals from trusted cereal brands that cater to different tastes and dietary needs. From classic favorites like corn flakes and frosted flakes to healthier options such as low carb cereal and sugar free cereal, our selection is designed to satisfy everyone.

history.title: How did TBA start?
history.item1: Since 2014, we have established TBA with one goal: to provide the best to customers in the Kingdom. We work with leading global companies to provide a select range of food products that are characterized by high quality and added value. Our distinguished history and experience in the market has made us a trusted name in the field of importing and distributing luxury food products.
history.item2Content: Despite the challenges facing global markets in recent years, the Global Brands Summit for Trade has continued to grow and expand, as we have significantly increased the volume of our imports to the Saudi market, and increased our partnerships with leading global brands. This includes expanding our distribution centers and warehouses in several Saudi cities.
history.item3Content: We aim to be the leading company in the luxury food sector in the Kingdom, and we aim to expand the distribution of our products to include additional markets in the Middle East and the world.
